title: The Mystery Of Fantasy
paragraphs: When morning came, the Filolial eggs started to crack.
“Hmm…?”
Father and the others woke up to the sound of the Filolials hatching from their eggs.
“It’s already morning…? Yaaawn…”
“The Filolials have already hatched!”
“Oh? Let’s see.”
Father and the others looked at the newly hatched Filolials, who were curiously glancing around.
“Wow, they’re so cute! Like little chicks!”
“They’re just hatchlings now. These are the same birds that will pull carriages?”
“It’s quite mysterious, isn’t it? Put an egg in an incubator, and they hatch in just a day.”
“Must be an ‘otherworld’ thing.”
Haha, indeed, Filolial eggs possess a mysterious power. But I don’t think too deeply about it. After all, they are Filolials!
“So, the one I registered is this one, right?”
“Pii!”
Sakura-chan chirped energetically in response.
“The other two belong to you, Motoyasu. Have you already decided on their names?”
“Of course! My previous Father named them for me.”
“Oh? What names did he choose?”
“The white female is Yuki-chan, the yellow male is Kou, and the pink female is Sakura-chan!”
“Pii!” “Pii!” “Pii!”
Yuki-chan and the others chirped in unison, striking adorable poses. They are not only charming but also brimming with intelligence!
“They seem pretty smart.”
“Yes, their coordination is almost uncanny.”
“So, are we leveling them up today?”
“Indeed!”
“From what I’ve heard, this power leveling thing means these little ones will grow rapidly, right?”
“Well, considering this is another world, I suppose it makes sense.”
“It’s amazing how ‘otherworld logic’ explains everything so easily.”
“Demi-humans also grow to some extent based on their level.”
“The mysteries of fantasy worlds… No wonder people mistake this for a game.”
Father gently picked up Sakura-chan and stroked her throat. They all looked so content.
“Ah, that’s unfair, Naofumi-san! Let me do it too!”
“Hmph.”
Ren acted uninterested, but I noticed him stealing glances from time to time. He can’t fool my eyes!
“Here, Ren, you should pet them too.”
Sakura-chan chirped affectionately.
“…Fine, I guess.”
Ren and Itsuki both started petting them gently. But I could tell. They weren’t very good at it. Yuki-chan and Kou seemed slightly uncomfortable. Sakura-chan, being more easygoing, didn’t resist.
“Mmm… So it’s morning already.”
It seems that Éclair has finally snapped out of her daze. Had she been like that the whole time? I have a feeling it was Father who quietly draped a blanket over her.
“Oh, they’ve already hatched?”
“Yep! Eclair-san, do you want to pet them too?”
“No, I have my duties as a bodyguard, so I’ll refrain.”
“So stiff… Well, whatever. Motoyasu-kun, I’ll leave it to you then.”
“Understood!”
Raising Yuki-chan and the others is no trouble at all.
“Oh, Father, could you have Sakura-chan join my party?”
Right now, Sakura-chan isn’t officially my companion. She’s still under Father’s jurisdiction.
“Got it. Sakura-chan, would you go with Motoyasu-kun for a while?”
“Pii!”
Sakura-chan chirped enthusiastically, as if to say she understood, and accepted my request.
“By the way, the fragments from Yuki-chan and the others’ eggs can be used to craft monster tamer weapons.”
“Alright, I’ll divide them among everyone later.”
“In that case, I shall bring back all sorts of souvenirs!”
“I’ll be looking forward to it.”
“Pii! Pii! Pii!”

With Yuki-chan and the others in tow, I set off while Father and the others waved goodbye. Now then, I should think of the most efficient way to level up Yuki-chan and the others. Might as well use this opportunity to power up my companions too.

I’ll make sure to surprise Father and the others! With practiced ease, I made my way deep into the mountains of Siltvelt, unleashing skills and magic along the way. This is even deeper than where I trained with Éclair.
A hidden region where dragons and ferocious monsters roam freely! Well, I’m pretty used to it by now.
“Aiming Lancer X! Brionac X! Gungnir X! Liberation Firestorm X! Hahaha! Too weak! You’re all far too weak!!”
This is practically becoming my hunting catchphrase.
“Pii! Pii! Pii!”
The Filolials chirped energetically in sync with my battles.
That only made me more fired up! At the same time, my level, which had dropped a bit, was starting to recover.
It’s all coming together—I’m getting even stronger! At this pace, we scoured through the hidden region.
Oh? This time, we’re finding some pretty decent gear! Previously, I had to be mindful of Melromarc’s influence and stuck to equipment that could only be used in Siltvelt.
But now, I don’t have to worry about that anymore!
The main issue is that Father and the others don’t have the necessary level or stats to equip this gear, isn’t it? Last time, when I tried to have Father wear it, he ended up unable to move.
“Alright, Yuki-chan and the others, it’s mealtime!”

I feed the Filolials, who are grumbling with hunger due to their level increases, with the prey we hunted. Of course, at first, they were eating chick feed I bought from the ranch, but that ran out almost immediately. At this stage, a Filolial’s stomach is a bottomless pit. And if they ever get a taste of Father’s cooking, that pit will only get deeper. HAHAHA!

I should also butcher some of the prey properly and bring it back as a souvenir for Father. Ahh, I really wish he could see how efficiently I hunt! I seem to recall that when Father rode on Sakura-chan’s back, he said it felt like that mustached plumber after grabbing a star. Or maybe I just imagined that?
“Piyo! Piyo! Piyo!”
Yuki-chan and the others are steadily growing. In just half a day, they’ve already reached level 40. Just how high-leveled are the monsters in this area?

Well, we’re deeper in than last time. Even so, these monsters are weaker than the Spirit Tortoise, so they’re just for show. If I analyze it using game knowledge, level 120 would probably be considered high here. Hunting in large numbers makes up for it.

If I could find a good leveling spot like Cal Mira Island, I could probably raise Yuki-chan and the others to a hero-tier level without any trouble. For now, since I don’t know when they’ll be ready for a class upgrade, I’ll focus on improving their potential. This is a challenge to see how much we can grow before they’re strong enough to carry Father and the others. As for souvenirs, what should I bring back?

With that in mind, we continued hunting until sunset. By then, Yuki-chan and the others had surpassed their second form and were beginning to take on the appearance of full-grown Filolials. Their angelic form was cute, but their chick stage passed in the blink of an eye.
Ahh… that said, Yuki-chan and the others can transform back into their chick form if they want. Luna-chan was a great example of that. Luna-chan, who adored Keel.
It’ll be a while before we reunite with Keel. Right now, dealing with Ren and Itsuki’s issues comes first, and heading to Faubrey takes priority. But eventually, we will.
“Alright, let’s haul all this back for Father and the others!”

After returning to town, I used some gold to buy a second-hand cart and had Yuki-chan and the others transport the materials we collected. No worries—if any thieves or monsters show up, we’ll just trample them. The real problem is that we can’t fit everything onto the cart, isn’t it? We ran into this same issue last time.
“Can’t be helped. Let’s leave some of it here for now.”
All the loot is stored in my spear, so I can retrieve it anytime.
“Alright, everyone! Time to head back to Father!”
“Guaaa!”

Yuki-chan and the others cheerfully pulled the cart and took off. Ahh, fun times always pass in an instant. With a cart full of souvenirs, plus the materials and treasures we found in the dragon’s lair, we’ll be raking in a fortune. Hahahahaha! Under the night sky, we joyfully made our way back to Father.
